liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Harmonies on this track sound studio-quality, unlike other shows where they struggled [10]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Considered one of the best performances of this song, with flawless harmonies [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-11-17.sbd.patched.bec.22799.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 233 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1973-11-17.166358.aud.Conner.gems.flac1648**: audience recording; 27 songs; 197 min [2]
- **gd1973-11-17.sbd.ashley.23472.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: Distortion exists in the original source, worst in Looks Like Rain [4]
- **gd73-11-17.sbd.gardner.4749.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 184 min; rated 4.69/5 by 51 [5]. Said about its sound: Energy and musicianship are consistent and strong throughout the performance; The recording sounds crisp and clean, capturing the band's creative consistency; Slight hiss is present but easily remedied without affecting the overall sound [8][9][16][18]

## Around the show

- Imagines the experience of UCLA students attending this specific live performance [13]
- Recorded from floor-level seats on the right side of the venue [2]
- Jerry's jamming is less aggressive than at Veneta or Berkeley shows [14]
- Second set outperforms the first, which is hot but not over the top [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-11-17.sbd.patched.bec.22799.flac16**: source: SHNID 19896 and 4762 [1]. Also: Patches applied to specific tracks using DAT and cassette sources [1]
- **gd1973-11-17.166358.aud.Conner.gems.flac1648**: taped by Recorded by Charles Conner from floor level seats on the right side; transferred by Transfer of re-shelled master cassettes on November 15, 2023 using a Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 @ 24 bit 96 kHz and mastering on November 16, 2023 by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain; source: Sony ECM-22P mic (mono) > Sony TC-55 > BASF C90 master cassettes [2]. Also: First audience recording to circulate, shared on the 50th anniversary [2]
- **gd1973-11-17.sbd.ashley.23472.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>CASS>>DAT>>CDA>>WAV(EAC)>>SHN [4]
- **gd73-11-17.sbd.gardner.4749.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Signal path includes SBD, MR, C, DAT, CDR, EAC, and SHN [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bob Marks Grateful Dead: [1973-11-17 Pauley Pavilion, UCLA, Los Angeles, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-11-17-pauley-pavilion-ucla-los-angeles-ca-usa/) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Pauley Pavilion - November 17, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/november-17-1973) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Special Collections - Dave's Picks](https://store.dead.net/collections/special-collections-daves-picks) [23]
- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 5: Pauley Pavilion, UCLA, Los Angeles, CA 11/17/73 2012 US 3-CD set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-5-pauley-pavilion-ucla-los-angeles-ca-11-17-73-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2532995-790398) [24]
- Poster by disasteramnesiac.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead-Dave's Picks v. 5; Pauley Pavilion, UCLA 11/17/1973](https://disasteramnesiac.blogspot.com/2013/02/grateful-dead-daves-picks-v-5-pauley.html) [25]
